summary: Iteration 33 (HotForex account switch / rebase) frontend E2E tested at 1920x800 against the MetaApi mock. All 7 review items pass: (1) header live-demo-badge 'MODO REAL · HFM · CUENTA DEMO' with no red live-mode-badge; KPIs Balance $1,000.00 and Operaciones 2. (2) livemode-badge 'REAL · CUENTA DEMO · HFMARKETSGLOBAL-DEMO'; hfm-switch-account shows 'Estadísticas actuales: 12345678@HFMarketsGlobal-Demo'; rebase button is enabled; no hfm-account-changed. (3) Changing to 87654321@HFMarketsGlobal-Live2 → save, link and test each show the correct toast. The header switches to the red 'MODO REAL · HFM LIVE' badge, livemode-badge to 'REAL · HFMARKETSGLOBAL-LIVE2', and hfm-account-changed appears with the exact text; the block turns amber (border-amber-500/40 bg-amber-500/10). (4) After mock deposit -700 (balance 1000→300): the dialog title is correct, cancel closes it with no change, and confirm shows the toast 'Cuenta cambiada · capital inicial 300.00 USD · 2 operaciones anteriores conservadas'; the changed warning disappears and the text reads 'Estadísticas actuales: 87654321@HFMarketsGlobal-Live2'. (5) Dashboard: Balance $300.00, Equidad $300.00, Retorno 0.00%, Operaciones 2, PnL diario $0.00, Pico $300. In the Historial tab both trade rows show 'PERIODO ANTERIOR' with title 'Periodo anterior · 12345678@HFMarketsGlobal-Demo'. (6) With the bot running, POST /api/fx/account/rebase returns 409 'Detén el bot antes de cambiar de cuenta'; the bot was stopped afterwards with 0 positions. (7) hfm-plan-picker is visible, Probar conexión shows 'tipo Cloud G2 · fiabilidad alta', and there were no console errors.

issues: The dialog shows '(última verificación: 1,000.00 USD)' from the last Probar conexión, but the account equity is now 300 (the rebase correctly used 300). This can mislead the user about the new capital; consider fetching live equity when the dialog opens or adding a hint to test again.

action_items: Optional: refresh or show live equity in hfm-rebase-dialog instead of the stale hfm_verified_equity
critical_code_review_comments: HfmSwitchAccount: the rebase button only requires hfm_verified_at. It is enabled even when there is no account change; that is harmless but could rebase by accident. Consider asking for extra confirmation when !account_changed.
